CustomObject.description: Finance Center: one row per project per day, written by FinanceCollectionStateBatch (nightly). Powers the aging / DSO / collection-efficiency trend charts, which cannot be rebuilt from history. All amounts are in the PROJECT CURRENCY (Project__r.Project_Currency__c; AED when blank) — finance works in project currency, and a row never mixes currencies because it is per project. Cross-project rollups must convert at read time. Aging fields map to Aging_Bucket__mdt records by Sort_Order__c.
CustomObject.label: Finance Daily Snapshot
